title_zh: 处理课堂冲突前先听取经过

scenario.label_zh: 就课堂行为处理约定先了解情况
scenario.goal_zh: 听取家长对全班处罚的担忧，并约定询问相关师生后再决定回应方式

context_zh: 虚构的小学场景中，家长莎拉向校长摩根提出对全班留堂安排的担忧，双方约定先了解情况。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: Are you the principal? I would like to discuss what happened in my son's class.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Yes. Please sit down and tell me your concern.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: I came to protest against the decision to keep the whole class inside at break. My son says only two children were involved.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: I have not heard everyone's account yet. What did he tell you?

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: He said there was an argument over a ball. He is only in his first year of primary school, so he may have missed some of it.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Thank you for explaining that. I do not want to punish children without understanding what happened.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: Could you speak to the teacher before deciding on any punishment?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Yes. I will speak to the teacher and the children today. There will be no whole-class penalty while we review it.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: That is what I was asking for. Please let me know what you find out.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: I will call you after I have heard their accounts.
